text: Changes to app/auth.py require a review by the security team before they are merged.
Services must use only the Python standard library (no third-party dependencies without written approval from Platform Security).
New third-party dependencies require written approval from Platform Security before being added.
Every behavior change must ship with a test that fails without the change.
Tests that do not assert on the changed behavior do not count toward the testing requirement.
Keep the counters in memory, no Redis.
